batting.dismissal: c Kuldeep Yadav b LB Williams

balls.text: Kuldeep finishes with a boundary! Slower delivery dug into the track on middle and leg. Kuldeep continues swinging like a rusty gate and gets a top edge that evades the keeper and bobbles into the fence!

short and wide outside off. Kuldeep swishes himself off his feet. Not called a wide, and Kuldeep wants to check if that is the right call. It is not beyond the tramlines and it is not above Kuldeep's head either. Original call stands!

surely not another drop?! Full and wide outside off. Kuldeep opens his bat face and glides it uppishly towards backward point. Ramandeep dived forward but could not hold on. He then fired a needless throw, which allowed Kuldeep to get back on strike
slower bumper outside off. Kuldeep, having walked across his stumps, swings at it and misses it completely
takes pace off and bowls it on a hard length outside off. Kuldeep does not pick it and can only tug it back towards the bowler
streaky but they all count! Back of a length just outside off. Kuldeep backs away and has a wild slog across the line. Flies off the outside edge and beats third man comfortably!
off-pace on a length outside off. Kuldeep comes forward and chops it enough to the keeper's left to pick up a single
another short ball but this slides down leg. Some exercise for the umpire
sharp bumper on middle and leg. Kuldeep tries to bunt it into the on side but the ball whistles past his bat and his right ear
back of a length on middle and leg. Williams gets up on his toes and stabs it towards deep mid wicket
fires this length ball down leg. Williams tries to help it fine and seems to miss it. Not called a wide, though

soft dismissal! Excellently-disguised slower ball. Pitches on a full length on off and Rasikh has no clue this is the change-up. Too early into the stroke and reaches out way in front. Pops it straight to Shreyas at mid off, and Rana breaks a 29-run partnership!
banged in short on leg stump. Kuldeep gives himself room and jabs it towards deep cover point

another lbw appeal turned down! Speared in full on leg stump. Kuldeep has a swipe across the line and misses. Gets rapped on the pads but prima facie, that seemed to be heading down leg. Arora, though, has convinced his captain to review. No bat involved but as expected, Ball Tracking shows the ball missing leg stump. The impact itself was Umpire's Call, and KKR are out of reviews now!
hung up outside off. Kuldeep looks at the room and thinks he can smack this into the Bay of Bengal. Only connects with fresh air
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Rasikh digs it out towards mid wicket
length just outside off. Kuldeep walks across his stumps and swings at it. Chunks it off the inside edge into the on side
length outside off. Nips back in with the angle and goes well past the inside edge of Kuldeep's bat
hard length just outside off. Skids off the surface and beats Kuldeep for pace as he wafts at it
four to end the over! Short and wide outside off. Rasikh uses the width on offer and manages to glide it fine past the keeper!
shortish on the body. Kuldeep gets inside the line and tucks it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
banged into the track on middle and off. Kuldeep, for a moment, contemplated going for the upper-cut before bailing out of it
full on the pads. Rasikh uses the angle and glances it down to fine leg
slanted in on a length on middle and leg. Kuldeep dangles his bat and jams it off the inside edge into his pads

appeal, not given! Back of a length in the channel. Decks back in sharply and cuts Rasikh in half. Hits him high on the back leg, and that is probably why the umpire is unmoved. Harshit wanted the review but got no support from elsewhere
four more! Kuldeep is turning it on! Another low full toss on middle and leg. Kuldeep uses the angle and clips it through square leg, beating deep backward square leg to his right!
you have got to be kidding me! This goes awfully wrong and is bowled a mile outside off. Was a full toss too and that made it awkward for Salt to collect. Goes past him, and DC get five extras!

tipped over the bar! Short ball on leg stump. Kuldeep picks the length early and swivels inside the line, Helps it towards Rana at deep backward square leg. He jumps up to take an overhead catch but ends up pushing it over the fence!
low full toss, angling into off stump. Kuldeep pushes it down the ground
speared in full on middle and leg. Rasikh tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
banged into the track on middle and leg. Rasikh sizes it up early enough and ducks under it
full toss outside off. Rasikh is taken aback more than anything else and cannot lay bat on ball
length just outside off. Kuldeep lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes
fired in full on the pads. Rasikh comes forward and drives it to long on

huge appeal, not given! KKR review! Given a bit of air on a fullish length just outside off. This is the one that spins in too, and Rasikh, swiping across the line, misses it completely. Gets pinged on the pads but the umpire is unmoved. The main question here is whether this struck in line. No bat involved, and all eyes now on Ball Tracking It comes up and....Ball Tracking reckons the impact is just outside off. Very close call!.

was there an inside edge?! The finger goes up, and Kushagra is happy to walk back! Plenty of revs on this one, and this is a googly that pitches just outside off. Spins back in and Kushagra does not seem to pick it. Jams it off the inside edge into the flap of his front pad. Lobs up and Salt tracks it all the way to complete the catch!
length outside off. Kuldeep brings out the reverse and helps it towards short third
edged and four! Fizzed through on a length just outside off. Nips away a smidgen and takes the outside edge as Kuldeep prods at it. Salt is too late to react and it is far away from first slip too!
full just outside off. Kuldeep goes searching for it and chunks it off the inside edge towards deep mid wicket
safe, and it trickles away for four! Slowed up and bowled fuller outside off. Kuldeep swipes at it and gets a top edge. Loops up over where short fine would have been and hits the fence!
length on middle and leg. Kuldeep stretches forward and blocks

the stumps have been lit up, and Axar has to go! Shortish just outside off again. Axar stays back, trying to force it through the off side. The ball seems to nip back in just a shade and that induces an inside edge that clips the middle and off bail. Axar, for a moment, was preparing to run, only to find out that his stumps had been disturbed. DC sink further!
slightly shorter just outside off. Skids off the surface and beats Axar for pace as he wafts at it
back of a length just outside off. Axar waits in his crease and punches it towards extra cover. Good stop by the KKR skipper
shortish just outside off. Kushagra hangs back and turns it towards mid wicket
length on middle and off. Axar stays back and drops it behind point for a single
full on middle and leg. Axar comes forward and pokes it towards short mid wicket
hard length, slanting into middle and leg. Axar plays it back to the bowler
googly first up. Just a tad on the shorter side, though, and that allows Kushagra to pick it off the pitch and punch it to long on

edged and gone! Chakravarthy has another! Hung up on a length outside off. Seems to swerve away late and that draws the mistake. Stubbs wafts at it away from his body without any footwork and feathers it through to Salt, who snares a sharp chance!
floated up full just outside off. Stubbs presses forward and knocks it to long off
length just outside off. Stubbs shimmies around his crease before defending
shortish outside off. Axar goes back and jabs it towards backward point. Rinku misfields and ends up conceding a single
given a bit of air on a fullish length on middle and leg. Stubbs lunges forward and turns it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on the pads. Axar goes back and eases it out to deep backward square leg
length just outside off. Stubbs is caught on the crease and prods it towards long on

beautiful bowling! Slowed up deliciously on a length just outside off. Drops on the batter late and by then, Axar is committed to attempting a lofted stroke. Holds in the surface enough and straightens past Axar's flailing blade
length just outside off. Axar presses half forward and taps it gently into the off side. He wanted the single but Stubbs was not interested
back of a length on off. Skids off the surface and hurries Axar into his stroke. Dabbed towards backward point
fuller just outside off. Stubbs comes onto the front foot and pushes it to long off
googly on a length on off. Spins back in sharply and goes past the inside edge, hitting Stubbs on the thigh pad

induces the false stroke again, and taken this time! Floated up full just outside off. Pant's eyes light up looking at the extra flight and he tries to smash it into next week. Loses his shape completely and slices it high up. Shreyas settles under it at extra cover, and makes no mistake. KKR keep chipping away; DC keep sliding!
off-pace and dug into the track on off. Axar gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point
shot! Short, wide and put away again. Axar jumps up onto his toes and carves this over backward point. One bounce and into the fence!
four more! Short and enough width on offer outside off. Axar uses the pace, and upper-cuts it past third man!

just short! Banged into the track outside off. Pant swings so hard at it that he loses his bat (surprise, surprise). Splices it and fortunately for Pant, it lands just in front of Russell at deep mid wicket
hard length, angled into middle and off. Pant has a swipe across the line and gets an inside edge into his back thigh
Pant welcomes Arora back with a boundary! Short and wide outside off. Pant slashes hard at it and the ball flies between short third and backward point!
shortish outside off. Axar uses the depth of the crease and punches it crisply past extra cover. Russell tears across to his left from deep cover point, puts in the dive and keeps it to two
fired in on a length on off. Axar is rushed into his stroke a touch and pokes it towards extra cover
back of a length on off. Pant hangs back and stabs it towards deep mid wicket
full down leg again. Pant gets inside the line and scoops this over short fine leg. Does not middle this either and gets just two for his toil
back of a length on middle and leg. Axar goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket

goes straight up, and it goes down! What a moment in the game! Back of a length on middle and off. Pant looks for that half-scoop over short fine and skews it off the top edge. Rana runs around to his right from short third, circles under it and then shells the chance!
fired in on leg stump. Pant tries to paddle it fine but does not get the contact he desires. Loops up off the pads and bobbles towards short fine leg
shortish just outside off. Axar goes back and eases it down to long off to get off the mark
back of a length on leg. Spins away and Axar watches it till the last moment, defending into the off side
short and wide outside off. Pant gets onto the back foot and cuts it towards deep cover point
shortish on off. Pant rocks back and pulls it between deep mid wicket and long on. Venkatesh gives chase from long on and cuts it off

oh! Back of a length on middle and leg. Nips back in and cramps Pant for room. In defending it, he somehow lets go of his bat and the ball flies towards the bowler, while the ball rolls away into the on side
back of a length on middle and off. Axar gets up on his toes and defends
full and wide outside off. Axar goes sparring at it and scuffs it towards extra cover

stumps all over the place! Goes fuller, and slants this into middle and leg. Porel, feeling the pinch of his strike rate, walks across his stumps and looks for the scoop. Makes a complete hash of it, though, and the ball ends up making a complete mess of his stumps. Leg stump and middle stump have been uprooted, and DC are four down. Rana gives Porel a bit of a send-off too!
another sharp short ball on middle and leg. Porel tries the upper-cut but is cramped for room, and misses it completely
banged in short on middle and off and this zips through. Porel, who was initially shaping for the pull, has to take evasive action in the end
length just outside off. Pant presses half forward and punches it on the up towards deep cover point
length on middle and off. Pant stays back and works it towards deep mid wicket
hard length on middle and leg. Porel goes back and stabs it towards mid on
shortish again outside off. Porel hangs back and jabs it towards backward point
length on middle and off. Pant reads it off the pitch and pushes it off the back foot towards long off
excellent batting! Marginally short on middle and off. Pant picks the length really early, gets down low and dumps it over the deep mid wicket fence!
shortish outside off. Pant goes back and cuts it powerfully. Cannot beat backward point, though
back of a length outside off. Holds just a bit on the surface and Pant drops it into the off side for a sharpish single
hard length, angling into off. Porel stands up on his toes and punches it to mid off for one
14 off the over already! This is shorter but there is still width on offer. Porel flashes hard at it and gets it past Narine at short third!
what a shot! In the slot outside off. Porel gives Rana the charge, gets his hands through the ball and creams it over extra cover!
cleverly done! Dug into the track outside off. Porel hops up onto his toes and ramps it over the keeper's head. First boundary for him tonight!
length ball slanted across the batter outside off. Porel has a waft at it and only connects with fresh air
shot! Wide half-volley and that is fodder for Pant. Throws his hands at it and crashes it to cover point's left!
fullish outside off. Pant comes forward and pokes it towards extra cover
full outside off. No real swing on this occasion and Pant drives it down the ground to mid off
strays down leg. Pant does not lay bat on ball and the umpire calls it a wide

cleans him up with an absolute peach! Back of a length delivery that pitches on off and seems destined to come in. Until it doesn't. Nips away against the angle after hitting the seam and Hope is opened up like a deck chair. Tries to fence it away but sees the ball thud into the top of off stump. DC under early strife!
off the mark in style! Sharp bumper on middle and off. Hope gets into a tangle initially but keeps his eyes on the ball. Gets up and under, and hooks it over fine leg!
back of a length on off. Porel punches it down the ground to mid off and scampers across to the other end
another yorker, just outside off. Does not swing back in and Hope, searching for it away from his body, is beaten

has that been taken cleanly?! Looks like it, and Starc has broken this game open further! In the slot, angling into middle and off. JFM clears his front leg and has a swish at it. Miscues it a little and arrows it flat towards deep square leg. Venkatesh seems to misjudge it initially but then stoops down low on the fence to pick up the catch, inches off the turf. Both DC openers now back in the shed!
four more! Goes for the yorker but it does not come out the way Starc would have wanted. It is a full toss outside off and JFM can slice it over backward point!
JFM goes big! Dug in short on off and that is just what JFM is waiting for. Opens up his stance, swings at it with abandon and swats it over wide long on!
full on the pads. Porel tucks it away off his pads towards deep backward square leg, where Ramandeep sprawls to his left and saves three
searing yorker, bowled at 143.8kph on off stump. JFM just manages to get his bat down in time and squeezes it out behind square
length just outside off. Porel hares down the track and then slogs at it wildly. Gets nowhere close to the ball
length outside off. A hint of movement away as Porel comes forward and pushes it towards extra cover

zipped in full on the pads, following Porel who backed away. He tries to force it through mid wicket but misses it completely. Rolls off the pads towards mid wicket. JFM wanted the single but was sent back in time
length delivery that slides down leg. Porel swings at it and misses. Called a wide

KKR go up in appeal, and they opt for the review! And Shaw is walking off as soon as KKR have done so. Early drama at the Eden Gardens! Full ball, swerving into the pads. On most days, Shaw would have clipped this away into the on side. But this time, he only manages a tickle that Salt gobbles up smartly to his left. Arora has another powerplay wicket against the Capitals!
back of a length outside off. Shaw gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point
nails the in-swinging yorker on leg stump. JFM cannot keep track of it and misses it. Pings off the back leg into the on side
banged into the track and this slides a little down leg. JFM swung hard at it and might have gotten something on it. Fell short of the keeper, though. Uh-oh, Arora has overstepped...

full toss and JFM has been rapped on the pads! Swings into leg stump. JFM tries to flick it away and seems to play all over it. Starc goes up in appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Shreyas indicates there might have been bat involved and KKR decide against the review!
back of a length on leg stump. Shaw gets up on his toes and tucks it off his hips towards deep square leg
pushed across the batter on a full length outside off. Shaw wafts at it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
shot! Full again, this time just outside off. A bit of shape back in but Shaw accounts for it. Rocks forward, presents the full face and cracks it back past Starc!
four more! Half-volley that swings into the pads. Shaw cannot believe what he has been served up and flicks it over mid wicket!
swing again but this is speared down leg. Shaw does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide

runs straightaway! Such a pristine start to the innings for Shaw. Full outside off. Shapes back in just a touch but the fullness allows Shaw to spring forward and thread it between extra cover and mid off!

Venkatesh finishes things off in style! KKR's sixth victory this season, and they solidify second spot on the points table! Right in the slot and Venkatesh climbs into it. Gets his hands through the ball beautifully and creams it over the wide long off fence!
banged into the track outside off. Venkatesh, after taking a step down the track, lets it go
off-pace on a full length on off. Venkatesh advances and drives it towards extra cover
what a shot! Length outside off. Shreyas decides very early that he wants to play the reverse swat. Gets into position and nails it over the deep backward point fence!
very full on middle and leg. Venkatesh brings out the sweep again and laces it towards deep backward square leg

mix-up between the batters, but Venkatesh is safe! Floated up full just outside off. Venkatesh tries to work to leg and gets a leading edge towards backward point. He wants the single but his captain is not interested. Thankfully for him, he is sent back in time and he can regain his ground via a dive. It was touch-and-go because his bat popped up into the air. There was just enough of his bat on the turf, though, and that saves him!
googly on a back of a length on middle and off. Shreyas drops it into the off side and picks up another run

tossed up on a length outside off. Venkatesh gets down on one knee and fetches it. Does not control the sweep and the ball skews off the top edge towards deep mid wicket. Williams makes up ground to his left but the ball falls just short
fired in full on off. Shreyas sits back in his crease and pokes it into the point region
shorter outside off. Venkatesh has a swish at it and chalks it off the under-edge into his back leg. Rolls away towards short third eventually
on a length outside off. Venkatesh skips down the track and jams it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and leg. Shreyas gets inside the line and tickles it down to fine leg
short outside off. Venkatesh gets onto the back foot and punches it towards long on
slower and fuller outside off. Shreyas nudges it into the off side and canters across to the other end
class written all over it! Marginally short outside off. Shreyas picks the length, rocks back and peels the outer cover off the ball, scything it past backward point!
slightly short outside off. Shreyas hops back and jabs it towards backward point
full on leg stump. Shreyas comes forward and plays it back to the bowler
fired in quicker on a length on middle and leg. Venkatesh stays back again and knocks it to long on
peach! Fizzed through on a length just outside off. Drops on the batter late and then rips away. Venkatesh has a nibble at it and is beaten all ends up
full on middle and leg. Venkatesh tries to flick it away and chunks it off the inside edge towards fine leg
length on middle and leg. Venkatesh goes back and turns it towards mid wicket
length just outside off. Venkatesh jabs it past extra cover and picks up another easy single
into the blockhole on middle and off. Shreyas jams down on it and squeezes it out past extra cover
back of a length outside off. Shreyas comes half forward and dabs it towards backward point
length outside off. Shreyas goes searching for it away from his body and squirts it off the inside edge towards fine leg
back of a length on leg stump. Venkatesh whisks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket

another misfield, and Williams is the culprit! Length outside off. Venkatesh gets on top of the bounce and drives on the up. Williams at deep cover point seems to have it under control until...it goes through his legs! Williams is having a shocker tonight!
back of a length on middle and leg. Shreyas uses the depth of the crease and works it towards deep mid wicket for a brace
length just outside off. A bit of hold in the surface and Venkatesh plonks it into the off side for a single
very full just outside off. Venkatesh looks for the reverse and scuffs it towards slip
slowed up and Kuldeep gives this plenty of revs. Pitches on a length on middle stump and then rips away, beating Venkatesh on the sweep
the slip is not going to come into play if you bowl there, though! A drag-down on leg stump and that is begging to be hit. Venkatesh rocks back and hammers it past deep backward square leg!
back of a length delivery that slides down leg. Shreyas glances it towards short fine for a single
flighted up on a length on off. Shreyas drops it into the off side and canters across to the other end
angled in slightly fuller on middle and leg. Shreyas pokes it into the on side
darted in on a back of a length just outside off. Shreyas stays back and cuts it towards backward point
oh dear! This is slowed up again, on a full length on off. Shreyas dabs it with an open bat face towards short third. Kuldeep goes down in instalments and lets it through!
fired in quicker and flatter on a length on middle and leg. Shreyas goes right across his stumps and laps it cleverly over the keeper's head. First boundary for Shreyas!
slowed up on a length outside off. Shreyas goes feeling for it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards the bowler
just over! Full on the pads. Venkatesh does not keep this down and just manages to chip it over the diving fielder at mid wicket. Porel, with a helmet on, was the fielder in question
length ball on the pads. Shreyas lets the ball arrive before tucking it off his pads to get off the mark
hard length on middle and leg. Venkatesh advances and flat-bats it towards long on. He was hurried into that stroke
back of a length on off. Venkatesh gets up on his toes and defends

miscued, and taken at third man! Hard length on off. Rinku tries to hack it over cow corner but gets it awfully wrong. Skews it off the top edge and the ball swirls towards third man. Kuldeep gets under it and does the rest. KKR lose their third!
back of a length on middle and leg. Rinku gets behind the line and taps it back to the bowler
length on off. Spins back into Rinku and he plays with the turn towards deep square leg
length on off. Shreyas comes half forward and stabs it towards deep cover point
shorter outside off. Shreyas stays back and jabs it towards backward point
length just outside off. Goes on with the arm and Rinku, despite being caught on the crease, pokes it towards backward point
flighted up full outside off. Shreyas comes forward and pushes it past extra cover for a single

knocks him over! Axar Patel strikes again! Darted in on a length just outside off. Keeps coming back in with the angle and skids on too. Salt, looking to cut it away, is beaten for pace and his off stump gets flattened soon after. A fantastic tone-setting innings comes to an end!
gives it air again, on a full length on middle and off. Driven down the ground to long off
Salt does not spare Kuldeep either! Tossed up into the slot on leg stump. Salt gets his front foot out of the way and smites it over wide long on!
fuller on leg stump. Rinku gets to the pitch of the ball and knocks it to long on
full on middle and off. Rinku stretches forward and blocks

deft touch! Googly on a back of a length just outside off. Rinku stays deep in his crease and steers it past slip. Rasikh gives chase from short third, dives but dives too early. A bit of imaginary swimming but the ball hits the fence!
floated up full outside off. Rinku gets a big stride in and pushes it towards extra cover
length outside off. Rinku lunges forward and defends
back of a length outside off. Rinku hops back and cuts it towards backward point
flighted up on a length outside off. Salt punches it on the up towards deep cover
slowed up on a length just outside off. Salt jabs it towards point
length on middle and off. Rinku goes back and bunts it between deep mid wicket and deep square leg. Hares back for two. The throw, though, is wild, and that allows a third

wicket first ball for Axar! Length ball angled across the batter just outside off. Narine tries to fetch it but does not get the power he is after. Hits it straight to the fielder at deep mid wicket, and Fraser-McGurk does the rest. The first ball of spin this innings yields the first wicket, but is it too late already?
79 off the powerplay! Another full toss outside off and Khaleel is not learning. Salt throws the kitchen sink at it and slices it between backward point and short third!
Salt is in a hurry! Gentle wide full toss and it gets the treatment it deserves. Salt flays at it and knifes it past backward point!

gets to fifty in pristine salt! 52 of the best from Phil Salt! Slower ball that lands right in the slot outside off. Salt can free his arms and bulldozes this over the bowler's head. A 26-ball fifty for Salt!
dug in short on middle and leg. Salt has a huge swipe across the line and chalks it off the toe-end towards mid wicket
four more! Shortish outside off. Salt uses the left-arm-over angle and opens his bat face to scythe it past cover point!
cutter on a length on leg stump. Salt comes half forward and prods it into the off side
length ball on the pads. Salt uses the angle and tucks it away towards deep mid wicket
shot! Back of a length outside off. Salt stands up tall and demolishes this over extra cover. The runs continue to flow!
slower delivery dug into the track on middle and off. Narine opens up his stance and pulls it towards long on

the wheels are coming off now! Borderline waist-high full toss outside off. Narine throws his hands at it and flays it past point. Narine looks quizzically at the umpire but the No ball has not been given!
Narine joins in on the fun now! Slower ball on a length outside off. Narine reads it like the morning daily and lofts it over mid off!
hard length on middle and off. Salt punches it towards extra cover and saunters across to the other end
full toss on off stump and Salt can only jab it towards mid wicket. He will be gutted at having not put this away
up and over! Back of a length outside off. Rather than going against the angle, Salt goes along with it. Gets under it too and muscles it over extra cover!
off-pace again, on a length outside off. Grips a touch in the surface and deviates away, going past Salt's attempted lofted stroke
cutter on a back of a length on leg. Salt gives himself a bit of room and taps it gently into the off side
full toss on the hips. Narine swings it away towards deep backward square leg. He will feel he missed out
banged into the track at Narine's body. He does not swipe at this and ducks under it with minimal fuss
hard length on middle and leg. Nips back in with the angle and breezes past Salt's flailing blade
this is bigger and better! Another slot ball, and this is on leg stump. Salt clears his front leg and biffs it a mile over wide long on!
right out of the screws! In the arc on middle and off, and this goes out of the park. Salt plants his front foot, swings through the line and pumps it over mid off!
slower delivery into the track on middle and leg. Salt is early into the pull and shanks it towards short fine leg
full on middle and off. Narine stays leg side and drives it towards mid off for a single
full and swinging into Narine's toes. He has a swish at it and misses it completely. Gets nutmegged too
into the blockhole outside off. Salt jams down on it and digs it out towards extra cover
shortish on middle and leg. Salt stands up on his toes and short-arm jabs it through mid wicket for a couple of runs
very full just outside off. Salt gives himself a bit of room and drills it towards cover point

length ball that slides down leg. Salt does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide. The Capitals think it has grazed the pad on the way and review. There is a spike when the ball is next to the pad, and the decision has been overturned. Not a wide!
back of a length on middle and off. Salt waits for this one and defends

that has gone a mile up, and Williams spills it! In the slot on middle and off. Salt looks to go downtown but chalks it off the toe-end. Launches it so high up that the ball comes down with snow on it. When it does, Williams makes a mess of it, running back from mid on. Might have gone through his hands and hits him on the chest!
23 off the first over! Goes short and at the body, but Narine is waiting for it. Hops up onto his toes, lifts up his front leg Calypso style and belts it past deep backward square leg!
off-pace on a back of a length on leg stump. Grips in the surface and deviates into Salt. Trickles away off the thigh pad towards square leg
lovely! Back of a length outside off. Salt gets on top of the bounce, stands tall and crunches it on the up past extra cover!
Salt makes Williams pay! Right in the slot outside off. Salt moves across his stumps, opens up his front hip and clubs it over wide long on!
